newsitem.title: DENMARK: French poll news damps Danish bond prices.
newsitem.headline: French poll news damps Danish bond prices.

text.p: Danish bond prices followed those on other European markets down on Tuesday, as the announcement of a French general election raised fresh doubts about the implementation of Economic and Monetary Union.
"The next month will be overshadowed by EMU, with France in focus," a dealer said.
At 0720 GMT the benchmark eight percent state bond due 2006 traded at 109.11, yielding 6.60 percent, down from Monday's closing 109.23.
The 10-year yield gap with Germany was unchanged at 74 basis points.
